actions.build: Change anything in the room at all: move, colour, size, make, say
actions.create_visible: Make a new thing visitors would see (typed)
actions.create_raw: Make a new thing with a raw CREATE message
actions.edit_record: Change a thing's record: label, date, description, category and the rest
actions.change_others: Change or remove a thing someone else made
actions.remove_room_things: Remove a thing the room's own code made
actions.appears_as: Change what is real and what merely appears; name a thing that only appears
actions.room_words: Change the room's own words: title, intro, arrival, guide, suggestions, help
